title: flake: plugin-approvals stranded-request-inspection.test.ts "an older strand outside the newest window is reached by the cursor" times out at 5 s under CI load (2 independent merge-queue hits)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a real flake that ejects merge-queue builds (queue-flake anchor #38220, 2 independent hits). Source: triage probe, R1454.

## 维护者速读

- 审批插件里一条测试会造出 500 多条已决审批再去查找，在忙的机器上超过 5 秒上限，已经两次把不相关的 PR 弹出合并队列。
- 按规矩算 p1。修法是给这条用例留足时间，或者减少造数据的开销；不能删掉或跳过它。

## Reading

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/stranded-request-inspection.test.ts`, "#37808 — past 500 decided requests, a new strand is still reported › an older strand outside the newest window is reached by the cursor within …", `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms`, which is a timeout, not an assertion.
- Independent queue hits: PR #38164 (runs 46115033565 and 46119645478) and PR #38167 (run 46121613844). Neither PR touches plugin-approvals.

## Fix

Seed the 500+ decided requests in one bulk write, or give the case a timeout matched to its measured cost on the slowest shard. ⛔ Do not skip or narrow the case.

Linked under topic #38081 (CI 稳定与合并队列提速).
